benchmark: pg_turbovec 1-bit sign-BQ vs 2-bit vs 4-bit: recall / storage / latency frontier

meta.latency_gate: AVX2+ required. Per AGENTS.md a pre-AVX2 host takes turbovec's scalar fallback (~1000x slower full-corpus scan); its warm p50 is not a publishable number. Recall/storage/build are CPU-independent and valid on any host.

query_set.caveat: queries are held out of the indexed corpus

ground_truth.method: exact top-100 in-DB seqscan (enable_indexscan/bitmapscan off) using the SAME operator the index serves (turbovec.<=>), so the GT metric cannot drift from the index metric

indexes.build_sql: CREATE INDEX bqbench_s1ma2_b1 ON docs USING turbovec (embt turbovec.vec_cosine_ops) WITH (bit_width = 1)
CREATE INDEX bqbench_s1ma2_b2 ON docs USING turbovec (embt turbovec.vec_cosine_ops) WITH (bit_width = 2)
CREATE INDEX bqbench_s1ma2_b1_L4096 ON docs USING turbovec (embt turbovec.vec_cosine_ops) WITH (bit_width = 1, lists = 4096)
